notes.title: Big Languages Update
notes.notes:
We've added new localizations, including:

- French

- Italian

- German

- Spanish

- Japanese

- Korean

- Polish

- Portuguese - Brazil

- Simplified Chinese

- Traditional Chinese

- Turkish



Thank you for playing EmyLiveShow visual novels ❤️

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Missing lines after some dice rolls
- Missing character skins in the gallery
- Camera zoom and movement
- Screen resolution problems

notes.title: Update №2
notes.notes:
- Added controller support 
- Fixed dice rolls being skipped under certain conditions
- Volume settings now are applying while you change them
- Fixed reset progress function, now it shouldn't reset resolution and language settings
- Improved Gallery UI
- Fixed missing and doubling UI sounds

notes.title: 1st Day Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed save and load bug
- Optimized sound design in dialogues
- Added item sounds
- Fixed achievements display in the gallery
- Added Mac version (if the game doesn't start, check the game files via Steam library)
